svg.data-chapters: [{"t":0,"text":"The sun warms the sea"},{"t":2,"text":"Water rises as vapour and cools into a cloud"},{"t":6.4,"text":"The cloud rains on the mountains"},{"t":9,"text":"A river carries the water back to the sea"}]
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The water cycle
svg.desc: The sun warms the sea, vapour rises and cools into a cloud, rain falls on the mountains and a river carries it back to the sea.
